items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: in other words Basie let me come up on the bandstand and play

ctx.x: And they used to let me come up on the bandstand and play when my feet wouldn't touch the floor. Count Basie has mentioned this many times in his personal stories of me to other people, you know. And it was that early that I was trying to play this music, and evidently I must have been doing something that was interesting because in other words Basie let me come up on the bandstand and play. And plunk on the piano, as I would so do. Which, this was very interesting to the older people.
